wages.text: Scanlon said she supports a $15 minimum wage as a goal but wants to phase it in carefully.
wages.quote: I support the $15 minimum wage as a goal, but I do think we need to be careful and probably stage it so we don't spur inflation.

immigration.text: Scanlon's issue page states she has worked to end family separation and to protect Dreamers and TPS holders.
immigration.quote: cosponsored legislation to end inhumane family separation practices and will fight to protect Dreamers and TPS holders

guns.text: Scanlon has cosponsored gun safety legislation to expand background checks and ban assault rifles.
guns.quote: She has cosponsored several pieces of legislation to close loopholes, improve background checks, ban assault rifles

abortion.text: On the third anniversary of the Dobbs decision, Scanlon said people should be able to make their own reproductive health decisions without political interference.
abortion.quote: Every person should have the power to make their own reproductive health care decisions, without interference from politicians.

cannabis.text: Scanlon voted for and cosponsored the MORE Act, saying federal marijuana policy is long overdue for change.
cannabis.quote: the time is long overdue for the federal government to bring its marijuana policy into the 21st century

health.text: Scanlon touted the Inflation Reduction Act's extension of Affordable Care Act subsidies to lower premium costs.
health.quote: Lower health care costs: reducing Pennsylvanians' premium costs by extending ACA subsidies for three more years, locking in average annual savings of $800 per person.

energy.text: Scanlon voted for the Inflation Reduction Act and praised its clean-energy investments and climate action.
energy.quote: The Inflation Reduction Act is a historic victory for Pennsylvania families and for our planet: delivering the investments we need to keep down health care costs, reinvigorate American manufacturing, and drive our transition to a clean energy economy.

voting.text: Reacting to a White House order she called voter suppression, Scanlon said government should protect the freedom to vote.
voting.quote: As a government, we should always protect people's freedom to vote, not rip it away.
